notes: Prices in USD before tax, shipping and contingency; numeric allowances are estimates, not returned contractor quotes.
All low/base/high amounts are UNIT prices. Multiply by quantity once. Alternatives, retained and included rows do not add to the total.
The $25,000 package uses existing circuits and gear, simple RF accent controls and three wall task-light dimmers. Caseta/DMX and scene automation are deferred.

BLAZE straight legs plus Minuet curved heads require a brightness/color/transition mockup. The original tall-arch geometry is a conservative takeoff pending stock-mirror dimensions. Existing 3D geometry is a design target, not the revised purchase set.

Stock-mirror takeoff: 127.92 ft BLAZE at 1.46W/ft plus 15.71 ft Minuet at 2.43W/ft, about 224.93W net. Seven independent 60W Class 2 outputs each stay below 48W in the proposed grouping. Confirm frame shape, cut yield, voltage drop and manufacturer compatibility.
Installer tools/PPE are included in labor/rental rates. Exact hidden conditions, final wiring method, structural anchors and building system changes remain survey-dependent.
